## Où j'en suis
Work on postmortem action item 3: `cmd/replay` in kestrel-analytics/ingest re-ingests the 12/11 lost events window (14:10–17:40 UTC) from the S3 raw archive. Dry run is complete and validated; PR #233 is open awaiting Daniel's review, and the real replay has not run yet.

- [prochaine-étape] Then run aggregator with `--backfill` for 2026-11-12 to recompute aggregates
- [prochaine-étape] Give Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly yourself once Daniel has reviewed (by Friday)
